dimensions.name: Money Laundering Risk
dimensions.description: Exposure to placement, layering, or integration of illicit capital through products, channels, or velocity.

dimensions.name: Terrorist Financing Risk
dimensions.description: Potential for accounts or payment networks to be leveraged for funding sanctioned or terrorist groups.

dimensions.name: Fraud & Consumer Harm Risk
dimensions.description: Vulnerability to Authorised Push Payment (APP) fraud, synthetic identity exploitation, or unauthorized account takeover.
dimensions.primary_framework: FCA Consumer Duty, PSR APP Fraud 2024, NACHA 2026

dimensions.name: Regulatory & Legal Compliance Risk
dimensions.description: Risk of statutory breach, lack of mandatory regulatory licenses (e.g. CASP/MiCA), or model governance deficiency.
dimensions.primary_framework: OCC TPRM, FCA Model Risk 2026, FinCEN AI Guidance
